subject.title: [Bug]: Non-main agent may miss models.json and fail with "Unknown model" when provider plan is empty

question: Should the missing non-main models.json skip path be fixed by one-time bootstrap from the default agent, read-through inheritance, or an early actionable failure?
rationale: Repository policy treats provider routing, auth state, startup fallback behavior, and persisted catalog state as compatibility-sensitive, and the linked PRs choose different boundaries with different upgrade and credential implications.

options.title: Rebase narrow bootstrap fix
options.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/58373 or an equivalent replacement that creates a missing non-main models.json once and never overwrites existing per-agent catalogs.

options.title: Prefer read-through inheritance
options.body: Use the catalog-inheritance direction only if maintainers want runtime fallback and it can cover this missing-root-file case without unsafe provider config mixing.

options.title: Fail early with guidance
options.body: Add an actionable startup/session error instead of copying or inheriting catalogs if persistent fallback behavior is the wrong product boundary.

recommendation.title: Rebase narrow bootstrap fix
recommendation.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/58373 or an equivalent replacement that creates a missing non-main models.json once and never overwrites existing per-agent catalogs.

likelyOwner.reason: Current source-history and adjacent model-catalog refactor history make this the clearest owner for the provider/auth fallback boundary choice.
